title: Churchkhela
description: A classic dish from Georgia, featuring walnut, grape juice, white granulated sugar, all-purpose flour. A practical home-kitchen version with measured step ingredients and clear cooking methods.

steps.instruction: Thread the walnut halves closely on clean food-safe cotton string and tie a loop for hanging.
Whisk flour into cold grape juice until smooth, add sugar and simmer while stirring for 15 minutes to make a thick grape pudding (tatara).
Dip the walnut strings fully into warm grape pudding, hang to set, then repeat for a thicker coating. Air-dry in a clean ventilated space until firm, typically several days; discard any showing mold.
Remove the string before eating. Slice the dried churchkhela and serve as a confection.
